# Holdmybag

> Holdmybag offers self-service luggage storage in smart lockers at hotels, train stations, shopping centres and other central locations in Europe. Lockers can be booked online in advance or on site, many locations are accessible 24/7. Holdmybag is operated by Holdmybag GmbH, the contractual partner for every booking.

Holdmybag is a network of luggage lockers for travellers, commuters and shoppers. Each location has its own page with address, map coordinates, opening hours, prices per locker size, booking options and amenities. Every page also exists as Markdown (see the links below). Prices and opening hours differ per location; only the data on the location pages is authoritative.

## Operator

- Holdmybag GmbH operates Holdmybag and is the contractual partner of every customer (bookings, payments, terms and conditions).
- Legal notice: https://holdmybag.net/en/legal-notice/; contact: office@holdmybag.net.
- The locker hardware and software are supplied by the technology provider Variocube.

## How booking works

- Online in advance: locations with online booking link to their booking page on https://booking.holdmybag.net. Choose locker size and duration, pay online and receive the access code by email.
- On site by smartphone: scan the QR code on the locker, choose a compartment and pay on your phone.
- On site at the terminal: choose a compartment on the screen and pay by card or contactless.
- Which of these channels a location offers, its payment methods, opening hours (24/7 or weekly hours) and prices are listed on each location page.
- Payment methods used at Holdmybag locations: Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, TWINT.

## Data

- [locations.json](https://holdmybag.net/content/locations.json): JSON array with one object per published location (German texts; English texts in https://holdmybag.net/en/content/locations.json). Fields:
  - `id`: internal location id
  - `slug`: stable identifier, also used in the page URLs
  - `title`: location name
  - `lat, lng`: WGS84 coordinates (numbers or null)
  - `address, zip, city, country`: postal address (country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code)
  - `url`: absolute URL of the German page
  - `url_en`: absolute URL of the English page (only when the English site is built)
  - `md_url`: absolute URL of the Markdown version of the page (same language as the file)
  - `booking_url`: online booking link, usually on booking.holdmybag.net; only valid when booking_online is true
  - `booking_online, booking_qr, booking_terminal`: booking channels: online in advance / on site via QR code and smartphone / on site at the terminal
  - `is_24_7`: true = accessible around the clock, false = see opening_hours, null = unknown
  - `opening_hours`: weekly windows, e.g. {"mon": [["08:00", "20:00"]], ...}; days: mon..sun; an empty list means closed
  - `price_text`: free-text price summary (prices in the location's currency), may be null
  - `category`: legacy booking category (online / onsite / online_onsite)
  - `image_url`: main image (site-relative or absolute URL)
  - `description_short`: short description
  - `translation_fallback`: true if some English texts fall back to German

#### Getting there and access

Dear Guest! We are pleased to introduce our new luggage storage service! Our lockers meet strict security standards and feature a modern user interface. You can reserve your preferred storage time either in advance or upon arrival. The lockers are located in the basement of the building, directly next to the laundry room. To reach them, open the black metal door next to the vending machine on the ground floor, go down the stairs, turn left, and continue straight ahead until you reach the laundry room. After collecting your luggage, you can easily take the elevator back to the ground floor. The premises are secured with security code 24/7. We are happy to assist you with any questions or concerns and can be reached at any time by phone at +43, 660, or 6614006. Thank you for your trust! City Stay Vienna Our lockers meet strict security standards and have a modern user interface. You have the option to reserve your personal storage times either in advance or upon arrival on site. The storage lockers are located in the basement of the building right next to the laundry room. To get there, open the black metal door next to the drinks machine on the ground floor, go down the stairs, turn left and continue straight on until you reach the laundry room. After you have collected your luggage, you can easily take the elevator to the ground floor. The premises are accessible 24/7. We are happy to help you with all relevant concerns and can be reached at any time on +43 660 6614006. Thank you for your trust! City Stay Vienna

> Luggage storage (lockers) by Holdmybag
>
> Holdmybag Locker Store, just a 3-minute walk from Frankfurt Central Station, featuring 75 high-quality lockers in a video-monitored facility. Easy access via QR code, with the option to book in advance.

- Coordinates (latitude, longitude): 50.1094045, 8.6630254
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=50.1094045,8.6630254

#### Getting there and access

The Holdmybag Locker Store is conveniently located at Niddastraße 65, just a 3-minute walk from Frankfurt Central Station, and offers 75 high-quality luggage lockers. During the day, the store can be accessed via QR code. Lockers can be booked online in advance or directly on-site using the touchscreen display or a smartphone. The entire facility is monitored by video surveillance and is located in a secure street area. In the evening, the store is additionally secured by a roller shutter. Customers can easily open it using their booking and personal access code, ensuring safe and convenient access to their luggage even during evening hours.

##### Frankfurter Hauptbahnhof

The Holdmybag Locker Store on Niddastraße is just a 3-minute walk (450 m) from Frankfurt Central Station, easily accessible via the main entrance or side entrance.

> Die Schließfächer befinden sich an zentraler Stelle im Erdgeschoß des Waltherpark. Verschiedene Größen sind buchbar, unter anderem auch für das Aufladen von Handys/ I-Pads.

- Web page: https://holdmybag.net/en/location/waltherpark-spa/
- Deutsche Version: https://holdmybag.net/standort/waltherpark-spa/
- Markdown (Deutsch): https://holdmybag.net/standort/waltherpark-spa.md

#### Address and map

- Address: Bahnhofsallee 5, 39100 Bozen, IT
- Coordinates (latitude, longitude): 46.4974493, 11.3554717
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=46.4974493,11.3554717

#### Getting there and access

Öffnungszeiten auf Basis des Einkaufszentrums. Bitte informieren Sie sich über die genauen Zeiten.

#### Booking and payment

- Online: Reserve and pay for a locker in advance; the access code arrives by email. [Book now](https://booking.holdmybag.net/waltherpark-spa)
- On site by smartphone: Scan the QR code on the locker, choose a compartment and pay on your phone. Payment methods: Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal.
- On site at the terminal: Choose a compartment on the screen and pay by card or contactless at the terminal. Payment methods: Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal.

Package prices (total):

Package price: covers the entire booking period.
